query:
SELECT recording AS "recording!", id AS "id!"
                FROM (
                    SELECT rct.recording, g.id,
                           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY rct.recording ORDER BY g.id) AS rn
                    FROM recording_tag rct
                    JOIN tag t ON t.id = rct.tag
                    JOIN genre g ON g.name = t.name
                    WHERE rct.recording = ANY($1)
                      AND ($2::int IS NULL OR g.id > $2)
                ) ranked
                WHERE rn <= $3
                ORDER BY recording, id
